decisions.reason: Requiring supporting links in completed task artifacts does not change the existing assignment deadlines or completion schedule.
The source concerns the contents of submitted task artifacts and does not change the fallback behavior for independently selecting work.
The source requires links alongside completed work but does not change the requirement to mark completed tasks in ClickUp.

The source does not specifically identify the CRM structure document, and the supplied context later associates the requested links with Pinterest tasks; propagation to the CRM deliverable is not necessary.
Supporting links in task artifacts do not alter the requirement that shared credentials be visible through Bitwarden.
